@Roth.Θ_option_le : ∀ {τ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype τ] {δ : ℝ},
  0 ≤ δ →
    δ ≤ 1 →
      ∀ {r : Option τ → ℕ},
        3 ≤ ↑(r none) →
          (∀ (j : τ), ↑(r none) ≤ δ * ↑(r (some j))) →
            ∀ {r₁ : ℕ},
              (∀ (j : Option τ), r j ≤ r₁) →
                ∀ {q : Option τ → ℕ},
                  (∀ (j : Option τ), 0 < q j) →
                    ∀ {B : ℝ},
                      1 ≤ B →
                        Roth.Θ B q r ≤
                          2 *
                            (Finset.Icc 1 (r none + 1)).sup' ⋯ fun l ↦
                              Roth.lem6Φ q r (Roth.lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l) l +
                                  √(Roth.lem6Φ q r (Roth.lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l) l) +
                                √δ

theorem Roth.Θ_option_le.{u_2} : ∀ {τ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype τ] {δ : ℝ},
  0 ≤ δ →
    δ ≤ 1 →
      ∀ {r : Option τ → ℕ},
        3 ≤ ↑(r none) →
          (∀ (j : τ), ↑(r none) ≤ δ * ↑(r (some j))) →
            ∀ {r₁ : ℕ},
              (∀ (j : Option τ), r j ≤ r₁) →
                ∀ {q : Option τ → ℕ},
                  (∀ (j : Option τ), 0 < q j) →
                    ∀ {B : ℝ},
                      1 ≤ B →
                        Roth.Θ B q r ≤
                          2 *
                            (Finset.Icc 1 (r none + 1)).sup' ⋯ fun l ↦
                              Roth.lem6Φ q r (Roth.lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l) l +
                                  √(Roth.lem6Φ q r (Roth.lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l) l) +
                                √δ :=
fun {τ} [Fintype τ] {δ} hδ0 hδ1 {r} hrp hratio {r₁} hr₁ {q} hq {B} hB ↦
  Roth.Θ_le_of_forall_index_le hB fun R hR h hh ↦
    Exists.casesOn (Roth.index_le_lem6 hδ0 hδ1 hrp hratio hr₁ hq hR hh) fun l h_1 ↦
      And.casesOn h_1 fun hl right ↦
        And.casesOn right fun hl' hle ↦
          LE.le.trans hle
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (Finset.le_sup'
                (fun l ↦
                  Roth.lem6Φ q r (Roth.lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l) l +
                      √(Roth.lem6Φ q r (Roth.lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l) l) +
                    √δ)
                (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hl, hl'⟩))
              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_le_true (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_zero)
                (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2)) (Eq.refl true)))
